name: studio_status
title: Studio status
description: What the studio shows now: its version, the library folder, the tutorial open in the editor with its number of steps, whether it is recording, and the page open in its browser.

name: list_library
title: List the library
description: Every site of the library with its address, the project folder it publishes to, its themes and their tutorials: path, title, steps, running time, status (draft, published, changed since publishing) and the agent that made it. Call it first, and reuse a site rather than create another one.

name: create_site
title: Create a site
description: Adds a site, the web application that tutorials document, with a first theme named General. publish_to is the folder of its web project that serves the tutorials, such as C:/code/app/public/guides. Leave it out when you do not know it.

name.description: Name of the application, such as Customer portal

address.description: Address the browser of the studio opens, such as https://app.example.com or http://localhost:5173

publish_to.description: Folder of the web project where published tutorials go (optional)

name: update_site
title: Update a site
description: Changes the name, the address or the publish folder of a site. An empty publish_to unlinks the folder.

site.description: Id of the site, from list_library

name: create_theme
title: Create a theme
description: Adds a theme to a site. Themes group the tutorials of a site, such as Billing or Onboarding, and carry a label color.

site.description: Id of the site, from list_library

name: create_tutorial
title: Create a tutorial
description: Creates a tutorial in a theme of a site and opens it in the editor, with the built-in browser on the address of the site, ready to record. The title is short and starts with a verb, such as Change the payment method.

site.description: Id of the site, from list_library

theme.description: Id of the theme (optional, the first theme of the site by default)

description.description: One sentence on what the tutorial shows (optional)

name: open_tutorial
title: Open a tutorial
description: Opens a tutorial of the library in the editor, to record more steps or to edit it.

path.description: Path of the tutorial, site/theme/tutorial, from list_library

name: read_tutorial
title: Read a tutorial
description: The tutorial open in the editor, or the one at path: its title and description, then each step with its number, title, text, running time, transition, page address, cursor and markers (number, title, text, and position from 0 to 1 of its screenshot).

path.description: Path of the tutorial (optional, the open one by default)

name: update_tutorial
title: Rename a tutorial
description: Changes the title or the description of the tutorial open in the editor.

name: open_page
title: Open a page
description: Opens an address in the browser of the studio, in the Site view of the editor, and waits for the page to load. A tutorial must be open: the browser lives in its editor.

name: look
title: Look at the page
description: Shows you the page open in the browser of the studio: a screenshot of what is on screen, its address and title, how far it is scrolled, and the elements you can act on, each with a ref (e1, e2...), its role, its name and its box in CSS pixels of the window. Elements above or below the window come with on_screen false. Look again after each change of the page: a ref belongs to the page as you last saw it. Field values are never read.

name: click
title: Click
description: Clicks an element as a person would with the mouse, after scrolling it into view. While the studio records, the click becomes a step: the screen just before the click, the cursor and a marker named after the element. Returns that step and the page the click led to.

ref.description: Ref of the element, from the latest look

name: type_text
title: Type text
description: Types text into a field, replacing what it held, or picks the option of a select by its text. Use demo data only. The text shows on the screenshot of the next step: typing makes no step by itself.

ref.description: Ref of the field, from the latest look

submit.description: Submit the form after typing, like Enter (false by default)

name: press_key
title: Press a key
description: Presses a key in the page, on the element that has the focus.

name: scroll
title: Scroll
description: Scrolls the page to an element, to its top or bottom, or by a number of CSS pixels (positive goes down). While recording, the next step shows the page scrolled this way.

ref.description: Ref of an element to bring to the middle of the window

name: go_back
title: Go back
description: Goes back to the previous page in the browser of the studio.

name: start_recording
title: Start recording
description: Starts recording the tutorial open in the editor. From now on, each click becomes a step, as when the creator records by hand.

name: stop_recording
title: Stop recording
description: Stops recording. The last screen joins the tutorial, unless the last step already shows it.

name: capture_step
title: Capture a step
description: Adds the page as it is now as a step, recording or not, such as the result of an action. With a ref, a numbered marker points at that element, named marker_title.

title.description: Title of the step, starting with a verb

text.description: One or two sentences under the title

name: update_step
title: Update a step
description: Changes the title, the text, the running time or the transition of a step of the open tutorial.

text.description: One or two sentences shown under the title

duration_ms.description: How long the step plays, from 1000 to 30000

name: add_marker
title: Add a marker
description: Adds a numbered marker to a step, at a point of its screenshot given from 0 to 1 of its width and height. read_tutorial gives the positions of the markers and of the cursor.

name: update_marker
title: Update a marker
description: Changes the title, the text or the position of a marker of a step.

marker.description: Number of the marker in the step, from 1

name: remove_marker
title: Remove a marker
description: Removes a marker from a step of the open tutorial. The creator can undo it in the studio.

marker.description: Number of the marker in the step, from 1

name: move_step
title: Move a step
description: Moves a step to another place in the tutorial.

name: delete_step
title: Delete a step
description: Deletes a step of the open tutorial. The creator can undo it in the studio.

name: undo
title: Undo
description: Undoes the last change of the open tutorial, like Ctrl+Z in the studio.

name: show_step
title: Show a step
description: Shows a step in the editor, its screenshot with its markers, the way the creator edits it, and gives you a picture of the studio window to check it.

name: play_tutorial
title: Play the tutorial
description: Plays the open tutorial in the player of the editor, from the start or from a step, for the creator to watch.

from_step.description: Number of the step to start from (optional)

name: publish_tutorial
title: Publish a tutorial
description: Publishes the tutorial into the project folder its site publishes to, where the web application serves it, and returns that folder. The open tutorial by default.

name: export_tutorial
title: Export a ZIP
description: Writes the tutorial as a ZIP archive, guide.json and its screenshots, the archive the browser extension and the command line open. The open tutorial by default.

target.description: Path of the archive to write, ending in .zip
